items.verse: وَلَقَدْ نَصَرَكُمُ ٱللَّهُ بِبَدْرٍۢ وَأَنتُمْ أَذِلَّةٌۭ ۖ فَٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ لَعَلَّكُمْ تَشْكُرُونَ
items.verseEn: And already had Allāh given you victory at [the battle of] Badr while you were weak [i.e., few in number]. Then fear Allāh; perhaps you will be grateful.

items.verse: لَقَدْ نَصَرَكُمُ ٱللَّهُ فِى مَوَاطِنَ كَثِيرَةٍۢ ۙ وَيَوْمَ حُنَيْنٍ ۙ إِذْ أَعْجَبَتْكُمْ كَثْرَتُكُمْ فَلَمْ تُغْنِ عَنكُمْ شَيْـًۭٔا وَضَاقَتْ عَلَيْكُمُ ٱلْأَرْضُ بِمَا رَحُبَتْ ثُمَّ وَلَّيْتُم مُّدْبِرِينَ
items.verseEn: Allāh has already given you victory in many regions and [even] on the day of Ḥunayn, when your great number pleased you, but it did not avail you at all, and the earth was confining for you with [i.e., in spite of] its vastness; then you turned back, fleeing.

items.verse: يَحْسَبُونَ ٱلْأَحْزَابَ لَمْ يَذْهَبُوا۟ ۖ وَإِن يَأْتِ ٱلْأَحْزَابُ يَوَدُّوا۟ لَوْ أَنَّهُم بَادُونَ فِى ٱلْأَعْرَابِ يَسْـَٔلُونَ عَنْ أَنۢبَآئِكُمْ ۖ وَلَوْ كَانُوا۟ فِيكُم مَّا قَـٰتَلُوٓا۟ إِلَّا قَلِيلًۭا
items.verseEn: They think the companies have not [yet] withdrawn. And if the companies should come [again], they would wish they were in the desert among the bedouins, inquiring [from afar] about your news. And if they should be among you, they would not fight except for a little.

items.verse: لَّقَدْ صَدَقَ ٱللَّهُ رَسُولَهُ ٱلرُّءْيَا بِٱلْحَقِّ ۖ لَتَدْخُلُنَّ ٱلْمَسْجِدَ ٱلْحَرَامَ إِن شَآءَ ٱللَّهُ ءَامِنِينَ مُحَلِّقِينَ رُءُوسَكُمْ وَمُقَصِّرِينَ لَا تَخَافُونَ ۖ فَعَلِمَ مَا لَمْ تَعْلَمُوا۟ فَجَعَلَ مِن دُونِ ذَٰلِكَ فَتْحًۭا قَرِيبًا
items.verseEn: Certainly has Allāh showed to His Messenger the vision [i.e., dream] in truth. You will surely enter al-Masjid al-Ḥarām, if Allāh wills, in safety, with your heads shaved and [hair] shortened, not fearing [anyone]. He knew what you did not know and has arranged before that a conquest near [at hand].
And [by] the sea set on fire,
And [by] the moon when it follows it

categories.name: مُكَوِّنَاتُ خَلْقِ الْإِنْسَانِ
categories.nameEn: Constituents of Human Creation in the Quran

items.verse: ٱلَّذِىٓ أَحْسَنَ كُلَّ شَىْءٍ خَلَقَهُۥ ۖ وَبَدَأَ خَلْقَ ٱلْإِنسَـٰنِ مِن طِينٍۢ
items.verseEn: Who perfected everything which He created and began the creation of man from clay.

items.verse: أَلَمْ يَكُ نُطْفَةًۭ مِّن مَّنِىٍّۢ يُمْنَىٰ
items.verseEn: Had he not been a sperm from semen emitted?
The Trustworthy Spirit [i.e., Gabriel] has brought it down

items.verse: وَلَقَدْ فَتَنَّا سُلَيْمَـٰنَ وَأَلْقَيْنَا عَلَىٰ كُرْسِيِّهِۦ جَسَدًۭا ثُمَّ أَنَابَ
items.verseEn: And We certainly tried Solomon and placed on his throne a body; then he returned.

categories.name: ذُرِّيَّةُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ فِي ٱلْقُرْآنِ
categories.nameEn: Descendants of Prophet Ibrahim in the Quran

items.verse: وَٱذْكُرْ فِى ٱلْكِتَـٰبِ إِسْمَـٰعِيلَ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ صَادِقَ ٱلْوَعْدِ وَكَانَ رَسُولًۭا نَّبِيًّۭا
items.verseEn: And mention in the Book, Ishmael. Indeed, he was true to his promise, and he was a messenger and a prophet.

items.verse: وَٱمْرَأَتُهُۥ قَآئِمَةٌۭ فَضَحِكَتْ فَبَشَّرْنَـٰهَا بِإِسْحَـٰقَ وَمِن وَرَآءِ إِسْحَـٰقَ يَعْقُوبَ
items.verseEn: And his wife was standing, and she smiled. Then We gave her good tidings of Isaac and after Isaac, Jacob.

items.verse: وَكَذَٰلِكَ يَجْتَبِيكَ رَبُّكَ وَيُعَلِّمُكَ مِن تَأْوِيلِ ٱلْأَحَادِيثِ وَيُتِمُّ نِعْمَتَهُۥ عَلَيْكَ وَعَلَىٰٓ ءَالِ يَعْقُوبَ كَمَآ أَتَمَّهَا عَلَىٰٓ أَبَوَيْكَ مِن قَبْلُ إِبْرَٰهِيمَ وَإِسْحَـٰقَ ۚ إِنَّ رَبَّكَ عَلِيمٌ حَكِيمٌۭ
items.verseEn: And thus will your Lord choose you and teach you the interpretation of narratives [i.e., events or dreams] and complete His favor upon you and upon the family of Jacob, as He completed it upon your fathers before, Abraham and Isaac. Indeed, your Lord is Knowing and Wise."

items.verse: وَوَهَبْنَا لَهُۥٓ إِسْحَـٰقَ وَيَعْقُوبَ ۚ كُلًّا هَدَيْنَا ۚ وَنُوحًا هَدَيْنَا مِن قَبْلُ ۖ وَمِن ذُرِّيَّتِهِۦ دَاوُۥدَ وَسُلَيْمَـٰنَ وَأَيُّوبَ وَيُوسُفَ وَمُوسَىٰ وَهَـٰرُونَ ۚ وَكَذَٰلِكَ نَجْزِى ٱلْمُحْسِنِينَ
items.verseEn: And We gave to him [i.e., Abraham] Isaac and Jacob - all [of them] We guided. And Noah, We guided before; and among his descendants, David and Solomon and Job and Joseph and Moses and Aaron. Thus do We reward the doers of good.

harf.hint: The straight path that believers are commanded to follow
harf.arabicVerse: فَٱسْتَمْسِكْ بِٱلَّذِىٓ أُوحِىَ إِلَيْكَ ۖ إِنَّكَ عَلَىٰ صِرَٰطٍۢ مُّسْتَقِيمٍۢ
harf.verse: 43:43 - So adhere to that which is revealed to you. Indeed, you are on a straight path.

deduction.title: The Offering that Altered Destiny
deduction.intro: In the earliest days of humanity, a soul offered a gift with pure intentions. Yet, envy lurked in the shadow of acceptance. Discover the story of this figure whose piety and tragic end are immortalized in divine revelation.
clues: I was among the very first generations of mankind.
I presented an offering to my Lord, and it was received with favor.
My brother's offering was rejected, and envy darkened his heart.
I told him, 'If you stretch your hand towards me to kill me, I will not stretch my hand to kill you; indeed I fear Allah, Lord of the worlds.'
I became the victim of the first act of murder on earth.
My blood cried out, and I was the first martyr of innocence.

identity.label: Who Am I?
options: Habil (Abel)
Qabil (Cain)
The Man from Ya-Sin
The Samiri
Luqman

trial.label: Trial/Event
options: His offering was accepted, causing his brother's envy and his murder
He was thrown into a blazing furnace but emerged unharmed
He constructed a massive ship under divine guidance
He was swallowed by a great fish and remained in darkness
He led his people through a parted sea
trial.answer: His offering was accepted, causing his brother's envy and his murder

location.label: Key Element
options: An accepted offering
A staff turning into a snake
A she-camel as a divine sign
A hoopoe bringing news
A golden calf worshipped

outcome.label: Outcome
options: First murder in history; his brother was condemned
Swallowed by the earth along with his wealth
Transformed into monkeys due to transgression
Destroyed by a fierce, icy wind
Drowned in a great flood as punishment
outcome.answer: First murder in history; his brother was condemned

deduction.arabic: ۞ وَٱتْلُ عَلَيْهِمْ نَبَأَ ٱبْنَىْ ءَادَمَ بِٱلْحَقِّ إِذْ قَرَّبَا قُرْبَانًۭا فَتُقُبِّلَ مِنْ أَحَدِهِمَا وَلَمْ يُتَقَبَّلْ مِنَ ٱلْـَٔاخَرِ قَالَ لَأَقْتُلَنَّكَ ۖ قَالَ إِنَّمَا يَتَقَبَّلُ ٱللَّهُ مِنَ ٱلْمُتَّقِينَ
deduction.verse: And recite to them the story of Adam's two sons, in truth, when they both made an offering [to Allāh], and it was accepted from one of them but was not accepted from the other. Said [the latter], "I will surely kill you." Said [the former], "Indeed, Allāh only accepts from the righteous [who fear Him]. (5:27)

scramble.hint: A celebrated verse praising the noble traits of patience and forgiveness — it describes them as a hallmark of firm resolve and strong character.
scramble.arabic: وَلَمَن صَبَرَ وَغَفَرَ إِنَّ ذَٰلِكَ لَمِنْ عَزْمِ ٱلْأُمُورِ
scramble.verseEn: And whoever is patient and forgives - indeed, that is of the matters [worthy] of resolve.
